recognitionRules: Keep the audience rail separate from the project list.

quote: Choose what you need to see. Start with the work that answers it.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use ROUTES OF WORK as an Arimo wordmark with three short aligned route rules. Keep the rules open, not enclosed in an app icon.
invariants: Keep the audience rail separate from the project list.
Use electric blue for navigation and selected routes on a white ground.
Build project rows from a strong name, concise metadata and a clear entry point.
adaptations: On mobile, turn the audience rail into a simple ordered set of links.
Case pages retain the blue route back to the portfolio.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
